paragraphs: Unless the context otherwise requires, references in this Business section to "ADMA," "ADMA Biologics," the "Company," "we," "us" and "our" refer to ADMA Biologics, Inc., a Delaware corporation, as well as its wholly owned subsidiaries, ADMA BioManufacturing, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("ADMA BioManufacturing"), ADMA BioCenters Georgia Inc., a Delaware corporation ("ADMA BioCenters") and ADMA Plasma Biologics, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("ADMA Plasma Biologics").

We are a U.S. based end-to-end commercial biopharmaceutical company dedicated to manufacturing, marketing and developing specialty biologics for the treatment of immunodeficient patients at risk for infection and others at risk for certain infectious diseases. Our targeted patient populations include immune-compromised individuals who suffer from an underlying immune deficiency disorder or who may be immune-suppressed for medical reasons.

Through our ADMA BioManufacturing business segment, we currently have three products with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA") approval, all of which are currently marketed and commercially available: (i) ASCENIV (Immune Globulin Intravenous, Human – slra 10% Liquid), an Intravenous Immune Globulin ("IVIG") product indicated for the treatment of Primary Humoral Immunodeficiency ("PI"), also known as Primary Immunodeficiency Disease ("PIDD") or Inborn Errors of Immunity, in adults and adolescents, for which we received FDA approval in April 2019 and commenced first commercial sales in October 2019; (ii) BIVIGAM, an IVIG product indicated for the treatment of PI in adults and pediatric

patients two years of age and older, and for which we received FDA approval in May 2019 and commenced commercial sales in August 2019; and (iii) Nabi-HB (Hepatitis B Immune Globulin, Human), which is indicated for the treatment of acute exposure to blood containing HBsAg and other listed exposures to Hepatitis B. We seek to develop a pipeline of plasma-derived therapeutics, including a product based on our most recently approved patent application under U.S. Patent Nos. 10,259,865 and 11,084,870 related to methods of treatment and prevention of S. pneumonia infection for an immunoglobulin manufactured to contain standardized antibodies to numerous serotypes of S. pneumoniae. We have successfully completed production of a pilot-scale batch and are conducting animal studies for our S. pneumoniae hyperimmune globulin program, SG-001. We anticipate submitting a pre-Investigational New Drug (IND) package to the FDA in fiscal year 2026, which could enable us to progress development of SG-001 directly into a registrational clinical trial. In September 2025, a Commissioner's National Priority Voucher (CNPV) application was submitted, and if accepted and approved, could accelerate FDA review by two fiscal quarters or more. Our products and product candidates are intended to be used by physician specialists focused on caring for immune-compromised patients with or at risk for certain infectious diseases.

We manufacture these products at our FDA-licensed, plasma fractionation and purification facility located in Boca Raton, Florida with a peak annual processing capability of up to 600,000 liters (the "Boca Facility"). Based on current production yields, our completed and ongoing supply chain enhancements and capacity expansion initiatives, we believe this facility has the potential to produce sufficient quantities of our immune globulin ("IG") products representing projected annual revenues greater than $635 million in 2026 and $775 million in 2027. These revenue targets translate to potential fiscal year 2026 and 2027 Adjusted Net Income exceeding $255 million and $315 million, respectively, and Adjusted EBITDA exceeding $360 million and $455 million, respectively.

In April 2025, the FDA approved our Prior Approval Supplement (the "PAS") for our innovative yield enhancement production process (the "Yield Enhancement") for both ASCENIV and BIVIGAM. This PAS approval amends the Biologics License Application ("BLA") approvals for ASCENIV and BIVIGAM and will continue to be the process by which we will manufacture these products on a go-forward basis. The production methods approved in this PAS have started to result in additional bulk drug yield from the same starting raw material source plasma volumes. This innovative process has demonstrated an ability to increase ASCENIV and BIVIGAM production yields by 20% or more from the same starting source plasma volume. Fiscal year 2026 will be our first full year of yield-enhanced production, supporting anticipated sustained margin expansion.

Geopolitical and economic conditions, war, terrorism or other military actions may have a material adverse effect on our business.

If we fail to comply with environmental, health and safety laws and regulations, we could become subject to fines or penalties or incur costs that could have a material adverse effect on the success of our business.
Business interruptions could adversely affect our business.
Issues with product quality and compliance could have a material adverse effect upon our business, subject us to regulatory actions and cause a loss of customer confidence in us or our products.

paragraphs: Below is a summary of the principal factors that make an investment in our common stock speculative or risky. This summary does not address all of the risks that we face. Additional discussion of the risks summarized in this risk factor summary, and other risks that we face, can be found below under the heading "Risk Factors" and should be carefully considered, together with other information in this Form 10-K and our other filings with the SEC, before making an investment decision regarding our common stock.

Although we achieved net income on a GAAP basis for the fiscal years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, we may not be able to maintain profitability and continue to generate positive cashflows in the future.

We contract with third parties for the filling, packaging, testing and labeling of the drug substance we manufacture, and we also obtain source plasma from certain third parties. This reliance on third parties carries the risk that the services and raw materials upon which we rely may not be performed in a timely manner, in sufficient quantities or according to our specifications, which could delay the availability of our finished drug product and could adversely affect our commercialization efforts and our revenues.

The estimates of market opportunity and forecasts of market and revenue growth included in our filings may prove to be inaccurate, and even if the markets in which we compete achieve the forecasted growth, our business could fail to grow at similar rates, if at all.

Both of our business segments and our facilities, as well as our suppliers and contractors, are subject to periodic inspections by the FDA and other regulatory authorities, which, depending on the outcome of such inspections, could result in certain regulatory actions, including the issuance of observations, notices, citations, warning letters or other enforcement actions.
Business interruptions could adversely affect our business.

paragraphs: The following discussion of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and notes thereto included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The various sections of this discussion contain a number of forward-looking statements, all of which are based on our current expectations and could be materially affected by the uncertainties and risk factors described throughout this Annual Report. See "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements." Our actual results may differ materially.

ADMA Biologics, Inc. (the "Company," "ADMA," "we," "us" or "our") is a U.S. based, end-to-end commercial biopharmaceutical company dedicated to manufacturing, marketing and developing specialty biologics for the treatment of immunodeficient patients at risk for infection and others at risk for certain infectious diseases. Our targeted patient populations include immune-compromised individuals who suffer from an underlying immune deficiency disorder or who may be immune-suppressed for medical reasons.

Through our ADMA BioManufacturing business segment, we currently have three products with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA") approval, all of which are currently marketed and commercially available: (i) ASCENIV (Immune Globulin Intravenous, Human – slra 10% Liquid), an Intravenous Immune Globulin ("IVIG") product indicated for the treatment of Primary Humoral Immunodeficiency ("PI"), also known as Primary Immunodeficiency Disease ("PIDD") or Inborn Errors of immunity in adults and adolescents, for which we received FDA approval in April 2019 and commenced first commercial sales in October 2019; (ii) BIVIGAM (Immune Globulin Intravenous, Human), an IVIG product indicated for the treatment of PI, and for which we received FDA approval in May 2019 and commenced commercial sales in August 2019; and (iii) Nabi-HB (Hepatitis B Immune Globulin, Human), which is indicated for the treatment of acute exposure to blood containing HBsAg and other listed exposures to Hepatitis B. We seek to develop a pipeline of plasma-derived therapeutics, including a product based on our most recently approved patent application under U.S. Patent Nos. 10,259,865 and 11,084,870 related to methods of treatment and prevention of S. pneumonia infection for an immunoglobulin manufactured to contain standardized antibodies to numerous serotypes of S. pneumoniae. We have successfully completed production of a pilot-scale batch and are conducting animal studies for our S. pneumoniae hyperimmune globulin program, SG-001. We anticipate submitting a pre-Investigational New Drug ("IND") package to the FDA in fiscal year 2026, which could enable us to progress development of SG-001 directly into a registrational clinical trial. In September 2025, a Commissioner's National Priority Voucher (CNPV) application was submitted and, if accepted, could accelerate FDA review by two fiscal quarters or more. Our products and product candidates are intended to be used by physician specialists focused on caring for immune-compromised patients with or at risk for certain infectious diseases.

We manufacture these products at our FDA-licensed, plasma fractionation and purification facility located in Boca Raton, FL with a peak annual processing capability of up to 600,000 liters (the "Boca Facility"). Based on current production yields, our completed and ongoing supply chain enhancements and capacity expansion initiatives, we believe this facility has the potential to produce sufficient quantities of our immune globulin ("IG") products.

Through our ADMA BioCenters subsidiary, we currently operate eight source plasma collection facilities in the U.S., all of which hold FDA licenses. This business unit, which we refer to as our Plasma Collection Centers business segment, provides us with the blood plasma required for the manufacture of our products, and also allows us to sell certain quantities of source and hyperimmune plasma to third-party customers for further manufacturing. In addition, one of our FDA-approved plasma collection centers also has approval from the Korean Ministry of Food and Drug Safety ("MFDS"), and ADMA BioCenters has FDA approval to operate a Hepatitis B immunization program. A typical plasma collection center, such as those operated by ADMA BioCenters, can collect approximately 30,000 to 50,000 liters of source plasma annually, which may be sold for different prices depending upon the type of plasma, quantity of purchase and market conditions at the time of sale. Plasma collected from ADMA BioCenters' facilities that is not used to manufacture our products is sold to third-party customers in the U.S. and in other locations outside the U.S. where we are approved under supply agreements or in the open "spot" market.

From time to time, we may provide contract manufacturing services for certain third-party clients. We also provide laboratory contracting services to certain customers and may provide contract filling, labeling and packing services utilizing our FDA-approved in-house fill-finish capabilities.

For the year ended December 31, 2024, we achieved net income of $197.7 million, the first time in our history that we achieved net income on a GAAP basis and generated positive cash flow from operations of $118.7 million. Positive cash flow from operations continued throughout fiscal year 2025. Our improved operating results were primarily the result of the substantial revenue growth and continued physician, patient and payer acceptance of ASCENIV.

In April 2025, the FDA approved our Prior Approval Supplement (the "PAS") for our innovative yield enhancement production process (the "Yield Enhancement") benefiting both ASCENIV and BIVIGAM. This PAS approval amends the Biologics License Application ("BLA") approvals for ASCENIV and BIVIGAM and will continue to be the process by which we will manufacture these products on a go-forward basis. The production methods approved in this PAS have started to result in additional bulk drug yield from the same starting raw material source plasma volumes and the Company believes it should experience meaningful revenue and earnings accretion accelerating further into 2026 and beyond. This innovative process has demonstrated an ability to increase ASCENIV and BIVIGAM production yields by 20% or more from the same starting source plasma volume. Fiscal year 2026 will be our first full year of yield-enhanced production, supporting anticipated sustained margin expansion.

In July 2025, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act ("OBBBA") was enacted, which includes numerous changes to existing tax law including extending or making permanent certain business provisions initially established under the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, which were set to expire. The OBBBA permanently eliminates the requirement to capitalize and amortize U.S.-based research and experimental expenditures, making these expenditures fully deductible in the period incurred. The OBBBA also permanently extends recognition of the accelerated bonus depreciation on qualifying assets in the period acquired. In 2025, these provisions resulted in a reduction of current income tax liabilities and a corresponding reduction to income tax expense.

In July 2025, we completed the acquisition of real estate in Boca Raton, FL for a total purchase price of $12.6 million. This real estate purchase is intended to allow us to expand our production operations and related activities as well as provide for certain redundancies for ambient and cold-chain storage of raw materials, work in process and finished goods inventory.

In December 2025, we entered into an agreement for the divestiture of three of our plasma collection centers for an aggregate purchase price of $12.0 million. As of the date of this Annual Report on Form 10-K, two of the plasma collection centers have been sold to the purchaser. The closing of the third center is anticipated to occur in the first quarter of 2026. After the divestiture of all three centers, we will continue to own and operate seven plasma collection centers. In conjunction with the divestiture agreement, we entered into long-term plasma supply agreements with the purchaser of the three plasma collection centers, further diversifying our third-party high-titer plasma supply base. Collectively, these actions reflect a deliberate shift toward a more flexible, capital-efficient supply model and are expected to deliver accretive cost savings beginning in fiscal year 2026, improve capital efficiency, support increased ASCENIV production capacity, and provide durable plasma supply confidence through the late 2030s.

ASCENIV is a plasma-derived IVIG that contains naturally occurring polyclonal antibodies, which are proteins that are used by the body's immune system to neutralize microbes, such as bacteria and viruses, and prevent against infection and disease. We manufacture ASCENIV under HHS License No. 2019 using a process known as fractionation. The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services ("CMS") has issued a permanent, product-specific-J-code for ASCENIV. Under the Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System ("HCPCS"), the J-code (J1554) became effective in April 2021. As part of our proprietary manufacturing process for ASCENIV, we leverage our unique, patented plasma donor screening methodology and tailored plasma pooling design, which blends normal source plasma and plasma from donors tested to have high levels of neutralizing antibody titers to Respiratory Syncytial Virus ("RSV") using our proprietary microneutralization testing assay. With our patented testing methods and assay, we are able to identify the high-titer or "hyperimmune" plasma that meets our internal and required specifications for ASCENIV. This type of high-titer plasma is typically found in less than 10% of the total donor collection samples we test.

ASCENIV is approved for the treatment of PIDD or PI, a class of inherited genetic disorders that causes a deficient or absent immune system in adults and adolescents (12 to 17 years of age). Our pivotal Phase III clinical trial in 59 PIDD patients met the primary endpoint of no Serious Bacterial Infections ("SBI") reported during 12 months of treatment. Secondary efficacy endpoints further demonstrated the benefits of ASCENIV in the low incidence of infection, therapeutic antibiotic use, days missed from work, school and daycare and unscheduled medical visits and hospitalizations. We believe this clinical data together with the FDA approval for the treatment of PIDD better positions ADMA to potentially further evaluate ASCENIV in immune-compromised patients infected with or at-risk for RSV infection or potentially other respiratory viral pathogens at an appropriate time. In the future, we may elect to work with the FDA and the immunology and infectious disease community to design an appropriate clinical trial to evaluate the use of ASCENIV in this patient population. Following FDA approval in April 2019, commercial sales of ASCENIV commenced in October 2019 and in 2023 we commenced manufacturing ASCENIV at the 4,400 Liter production scale. This expansion has improved the product's margin profile and increased plant production capacity as fewer batches are needed to support our revenue goals. ASCENIV's prescriber and patient base continued to expand during 2024, which drove record utilization and pull-through for this product. These elevated demand trends continued throughout fiscal year 2025, and we expect the product's rapid growth to continue through 2026 and beyond.

In June 2025, we filed our sBLA for the expansion of ASCENIV's label to include the pediatric setting for patients who are two years and older and we anticipate potential FDA approval in the first half of 2026.

我們是一家美國本土的端到端商業生物製藥公司，專注於製造、行銷及開發用於治療免疫缺陷患者及感染風險者之專門生物製品。我們的目標患者族羣包括因基礎免疫缺陷疾病而免疫功能低下或因醫療原因而免疫抑制的個體。

透過我們的 ADMA BioManufacturing 事業部門，我們目前有三項產品獲得美國食品藥物管理局（「FDA」）核准，且目前均已行銷並可供銷售：(i) ASCENIV（免疫球蛋白靜脈注射，人類 – slra 10% 液體），一種靜脈注射免疫球蛋白（「IVIG」）產品，用於治療原發性體液免疫缺陷（「PI」），也稱為原發性免疫缺陷疾病（「PIDD」）或先天免疫缺陷，適用於成人及青少年，我們於 2019 年 4 月獲得 FDA 核准，並於 2019 年 10 月開始首次商業銷售；(ii) BIVIGAM，一種 IVIG 產品，用於治療 PI 在成人及年齡兩歲以上的兒童患者，我們於 2019 年 5 月獲得 FDA 核准，並於 2019 年 8 月開始商業銷售；以及 (iii) Nabi-HB（乙型肝炎免疫球蛋白，人類），用於治療急性接觸含 HBsAg 血液及其他列出的乙型肝炎接觸。我們致力於開發一系列來自血漿的治療藥物，包括基於我們最近核准的專利申請（美國專利編號 10,259,865 和 11,084,870）的產品，該專利涉及治療及預防 S. pneumonia 感染的方法，針對製造含有標準化抗體以對抗多種 S. pneumoniae 病毒型的免疫球蛋白。我們已成功完成試規模批次的生產，並正在進行 SG-001 的動物研究。我們預計於 2026 財年提交預 Investigational New Drug（IND）申請包，這可能使我們能直接將 SG-001 開發進到註冊臨牀試驗。2025 年 9 月，已提交 Commissioner's National Priority Voucher（CNPV）申請，若獲批准，可能加速 FDA 審查兩個財季或更久。

年齡兩歲以上之患者，且我們於2019年5月獲得FDA核准，並於2019年8月開始商業銷售；以及(iii) Nabi-HB（Hepatitis B Immune Globulin, Human），其用於治療急性接觸含HBsAg之血液及其他列出之Hepatitis B接觸暴露。我們致力於開發血漿衍生治療藥物的產品線，包括基於我們最近核准之專利申請（美國專利編號10,259,865及11,084,870）所開發之產品，該專利涉及治療及預防S. pneumonia感染之方法，並針對製造含有標準化抗體以對抗多種S. pneumoniae血清型之免疫球蛋白。我們已成功完成小規模生產批次，並正在進行SG-001之S. pneumoniae超免疫球蛋白計畫動物研究。我們預計於2026會計年度提交預 Investigational New Drug (IND) 套件至FDA，這將使我們能直接將SG-001發展進階至註冊臨牀試驗。2025年9月，已提交委員會國家優先券申請（Commissioner's National Priority Voucher (CNPV)），若獲接受及核准，將可加速FDA審查兩會計季或更久。我們之產品及產品候選藥物，係用於由專門照顧免疫功能低下患者及其可能感染特定傳染病之醫師專科醫生使用。

我們在佛羅裏達州博卡羅訥（Boca Raton）設有經美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）許可的血漿分離與純化工廠（the "Boca Facility"），該工廠每年最高可處理至 600,000 升的血漿（the "Boca Facility"）。根據目前的生產產出、已完成且持續進行的供應鏈改善與擴充計畫，我們認為該工廠有潛力生產足夠數量的免疫球蛋白（"IG"）產品，預計 2026 年年營收將超過 635 百萬美元，2027 年則將超過 775 百萬美元。這些營收目標轉換為 2026 年與 2027 年的調整後淨收入，分別超過 255 百萬美元與 315 百萬美元，調整後營業息稅前盈餘（Adjusted EBITDA）則分別超過 360 百萬美元與 455 百萬美元。

2025 年 4 月，美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准我們的預先核准補充申請（the "PAS"），用以核准我們創新產率提升製程（the "Yield Enhancement"）用於 ASCENIV 與 BIVIGAM 產品。此 PAS 批准修改了 ASCENIV 與 BIVIGAM 的生物製品許可申請（"BLA"）核准，並將持續作為我們未來製造這些產品的製程。此 PAS 批准的生產方法已開始產生來自相同起始原料血漿體積的更多藥物原料。此創新製程已顯示能從相同起始血漿體積提升 ASCENIV 與 BIVIGAM 的生產產率 20% 或更多。2026 年財務年度將是我方首次實現產率提升製程的完整年度，支持預期的持續毛利率擴張。

paragraphs: 以下關於我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論，應與本年度10-K表報中所包含之合併財務報表及其附註一併閱讀。本討論各節包含許多向前看的陳述，所有這些陳述均基於我們目前的預期，可能受到本年度10-K表報中所描述的不確定性及風險因素的重大影響。請參閱「向前看陳述之特別說明」。我們的實際結果可能與此有重大差異。
ADMA Biologics, Inc. (以下稱「本公司」、「ADMA」、「我們」、「我們」或「我們的」) 是一家美國為主的、提供完整端到端商業生物製藥服務的公司，專注於製造、行銷及開發用於治療免疫缺陷患者及感染風險患者之專門生物製品。我們的目標患者羣包括因基礎免疫缺陷疾病而免疫功能低下或因醫療原因而免疫抑制的個體。

透過我們的ADMA BioManufacturing業務分部，我們目前有三種產品已獲得美國食品藥物管理局 (以下稱「FDA」) 的批准，且目前均已行銷並可供商業使用：(i) ASCENIV (人免疫球蛋白靜脈注射，液體，10% slra)，一種靜脈注射免疫球蛋白 (「IVIG」) 產品，用於治療原發性體液免疫缺陷 (「PI」)，也稱為原發性免疫缺陷疾病 (「PIDD」) 或先天免疫缺陷，我們於2019年4月獲得FDA批准，並於2019年10月開始首次商業銷售；(ii) BIVIGAM (人免疫球蛋白靜脈注射)，一種IVIG產品，用於治療PI，我們於2019年5月獲得FDA批准，並於2019年8月開始商業銷售；以及(iii) Nabi-HB (乙型肝炎免疫球蛋白，人)，用於治療急性接觸含HBsAg血液及其他列出的乙型肝炎接觸。我們致力於開發一連串來自血漿的治療藥物，包括基於我們最近獲得批准的專利申請 (美國專利編號10,259,865及11,084,870) 所開發的產品，該專利涉及治療及預防S. pneumonia感染的方法，此免疫球蛋白製造時包含標準化的抗體以對抗多種S. pneumoniae血清型。我們已成功完成小規模試產批次，並正在進行SG-001的動物研究。我們預計於財務年度2026年提交預先 Investigational New Drug (「IND」) 資料包至FDA，這可能使我們能直接將SG-001的開發進展至註冊臨牀試驗。2025年9月，已提交委員會國家優先券 (CNPV) 申請，若獲批准，可能加速FDA審查兩個財務季度或更久。我們的產品及候選產品旨在由專門照顧免疫功能低下患者的醫師使用。
我們在佛羅裏達州博卡朗 (Boca Raton) 的FDA許可的血漿分離及純化設施製造這些產品，該設施的年處理能力最高可達600,000升 (以下稱「博卡設施」)。根據目前的生產產率、我們已完成及進行中的供應鏈改進及擴充計畫，我們認為該設施有足夠的生產能力，可製造我們的免疫球蛋白 (「IG」) 產品。

透過我們的ADMA BioCenters子公司，我們目前在美國運營八個血漿來源收集設施，所有設施均持有FDA許可。我們稱此業務單位為血漿收集中心業務分部，為我們提供製造產品所需的血液血漿，同時也允許我們將部分來源及超免疫血漿出售給第三方客戶進行進一步製造。此外，我們其中一個獲得FDA批准的血漿收集中心也獲得韓國食品藥物安全委員會 (「MFDS」) 的批准，ADMA BioCenters也獲得FDA批准運營乙型肝炎免疫接種計畫。一個典型的血漿收集中心，如ADMA BioCenters所運營的，每年可收集約30,000至50,000升的來源血漿，其售價可能根據血漿類型、購買數量及銷售時的市場情況而有所不同。來自ADMA BioCenters設施且未用於製造我們產品的血漿，會出售給美國及其他我們在供應協議下獲批准或在開放「現貨」市場的地區的第三方客戶。
我們有時會為某些第三方客戶提供合同製造服務。我們也為某些客戶提供實驗室合同服務，並可能利用我們獲得FDA批准的內部填裝-標籤-包裝能力，提供合同填裝、標籤及包裝服務。

2025年4月，FDA批准我們的先期批准補充 (「PAS」) 用於我們創新產率增強製造流程 (「產率增強」) ，此流程對ASCENIV及BIVIGAM均有幫助。此PAS批准修改ASCENIV及BIVIGAM的生物製品許可證申請 (「BLA」) 批准，並將成為我們未來製造這些產品的流程。此PAS批准的生產方法已開始導致相同起始原料血漿體積產生更多原料藥產出，本公司認為應會在2026年及以後進一步加速產生顯著的收入及獲利增厚。此創新流程已顯示能將ASCENIV及BIVIGAM的生產產率提高20%或更多。財務年度2026年將是我們首次實現產率增強生產的完整年度，支持預期的持續毛利率擴張。

2025年7月，美國通過了《一項大而美麗的法案》（"One Big Beautiful Bill Act"，簡稱OBBBA），該法案包含許多現行稅法的變更，包括延長或使某些企業條款永久化，這些條款最初於2017年稅務改革與就業法案（Tax Cuts and Jobs Act）中設立，原訂於到期後失效。OBBBA永久廢除美國基於研究與實驗支出的資本化與 amortization 要求，使這些支出於發生期間可全額列為費用。OBBBA也永久延長對符合條件資產在取得期間的加速減損認列。2025年，這些條款導致當前所得稅負擔減少，並對應減少所得稅費用。
2025年7月，本公司完成位於佛羅裏達州博卡羅訥的不動產購置，總購置價格為12.6 百萬美元。此不動產購置旨在讓本公司擴展生產作業及相關活動，並提供某些環境溫度與冷鏈儲存的備用空間，用以儲存原料、在製品及成品存貨。

2025年12月，本公司與買方簽訂協議，出售三個血漿收集中心，總購置價格為12.0 百萬美元。截至本10-K年度報告日，兩個血漿收集中心已出售給買方。第三個中心的交易預計於2026年第一季完成。在出售所有三個中心後，本公司將繼續擁有並營運七個血漿收集中心。配合出售協議，本公司與買方簽訂長期血漿供應協議，進一步多元化本公司第三方高濃度血漿供應來源。這些行動 collectively 顯示本公司有意圖朝向更靈活、資本效率更高的供應模式轉變，預計自2026財務年度起帶來成本節省，提高資本效率，支持ASCENIV生產能力的提升，並於2030年代末期提供穩定的血漿供應信心。

ASCENIV 是一種源自血漿的靜脈注射免疫球蛋白（IVIG），含有自然產生的多克隆抗體，這些是體內免疫系統用來中和微生物（如細菌和病毒）並防止感染和疾病的蛋白質。我們在HHS許可證編號2019下製造ASCENIV，採用一種稱為分離（fractionation）的過程。美國醫療保險與醫療補助服務中心（"Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services"，簡稱CMS）已為ASCENIV發佈永久性的產品特定J碼。根據醫療常見程序編碼系統（"Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System"，簡稱HCPCS），J碼（J1554）自2021年4月生效。在ASCENIV的專利製造過程中，我們利用我們獨有的、專利的血漿捐贈者篩選方法和定製化的血漿池設計，將正常來源血漿與經我們專利微中和測試試劑測試後具有高中和抗體滴度的血漿混合，以對抗呼吸道融合病毒感染（"Respiratory Syncytial Virus"，簡稱RSV）。透過我們專利的測試方法和試劑，我們能識別符合我們內部及所需規格的高滴度或"超免疫"血漿。這種高滴度血漿通常僅在總捐贈樣本中少於10%的範圍內出現。

ASCENIV 已獲批准用於治療原發性免疫缺陷症（PIDD）或原發性免疫缺陷（PI），這是一類遺傳性疾病的類別，會導致成人及青少年（12至17歲）的免疫系統不足或缺失。我們在59名PIDD患者的關鍵性第三期臨牀試驗中達成主要終點，即在12個月的治療期間未報告嚴重細菌感染（"SBI"）。次要療效終點進一步顯示ASCENIV在感染率低、治療用抗生素使用、缺勤天數、學校及託兒所缺勤、未預約醫療訪問及住院的益處。我們認為這些臨牀數據加上美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准用於治療PIDD的核准，使ADMA更有潛力在適當的時間評估ASCENIV在感染RSV或有感染RSV風險的免疫缺陷患者中的應用，或可能其他呼吸道病毒病原體。未來，我們可能選擇與FDA及免疫學和感染疾病社羣合作，設計適當的臨牀試驗以評估ASCENIV在這類患者羣體中的應用。在2019年4月獲得FDA核准後，ASCENIV的商業銷售於2019年10月開始，並在2023年我們開始在4,400 Liter生產規模製造ASCENIV。此擴張已改善產品的毛利率，並提高工廠生產能力，因較少批次即可支持我們的收入目標。ASCENIV的處方及患者羣體在2024年持續擴張，推動該產品的紀錄使用量與拉動銷售。這些高需求趨勢持續至2025會計年度，我們預期該產品的快速成長將持續至2026年及以後。
2025年6月，我們提交了ASCENIV標籤擴展的sBLA，以包含兩歲及以上兒童的應用場景，我們預期可能在2026年上半年獲得FDA核准。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
儘管我們在2024年12月31日財年及2025年12月31日財年依照GAAP準則達成淨收入，我們可能無法維持獲利能力並持續產生正向現金流。
我們的業務可能因疫情、疫病或未知或新興傳染病的爆發而受到不利影響。
地緣政治與經濟情勢、戰爭、恐怖主義或其他軍事行動可能對我們的業務造成重大不利影響。
若我們未能遵守環境、健康與安全法規，我們可能面臨罰款或處罰，或產生成本，這些成本可能對我們業務的成功造成重大不利影響。
業務中斷可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
產品品質與合規問題可能對本公司業務造成重大不利影響，使本公司面臨監管處罰，並導致客戶對本公司或其產品的信心喪失。
若醫師、付款方及患者不接受並使用本公司現有產品或未來產品候選藥物，本公司從這些產品產生收入的能力將受到重大影響。
paragraphs: 以下為主要使投資本公司普通股具備投機性或風險的因素總覽。此總覽並未涵蓋我們所面臨的所有風險。有關本風險因素總覽中所提及風險，以及其他我們所面臨的風險之進一步討論，請參閱本文件「風險因素」節，並與本 Form 10-K 及我們向 SEC 提交之其他申報文件中之其他資訊一併考量，以作為投資本公司普通股之決定依據。
儘管我們在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日之會計年度內，已達成根據 GAAP 會計準則之淨收入，但我們可能無法維持獲利並持續產生正向現金流。
我們委託第三方進行我們製造之藥物原料之灌裝、包裝、測試及標籤作業，並從某些第三方取得來源血漿。我們對第三方之依賴，可能導致我們所倚賴之服務及原物料無法按時、足夠數量或符合我們之規格執行，這可能會延遲我們成品藥物之供應，並對我們之商業化努力及營收造成不利影響。
我們申報文件中所包含之市場機會估計及市場與營收成長預測，可能證明為不正確，即使我們所競爭之市場達成預測之成長，我們之業務也可能無法以相似速度成長，甚至完全無法成長。
我們之兩大業務分部及設施，以及我們之供應商與承包商，均會接受 FDA 及其他監管機構之定期檢查，根據檢查結果，可能會導致某些監管措施，包括發出觀察意見、通知、處罰通知、警告信或其他執法行動。
業務中斷可能對我們之業務造成不利影響。
